content: vite-plugin-pwa's workbox precache only includes js/css/html by default; other asset types including audio (mp3/ogg/wav) must be explicitly added to workbox.globPatterns (e.g. '**/*.{js,css,html,ico,png,svg,mp3,ogg,woff,woff2}') or they will not be precached for offline use. Large audio libraries should also watch workbox's maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes (default ~2MB per file) since precache generates a warning/failure above that ceiling.
